svg.title: Recent commits
svg.desc: portfolio: the link preview shows the current front page: the nameplate over BUILDING SOFTWARE THAT FEELS OBVIOUS and a plane towing the tgoyal.me banner, in a fifth of the file size (today). lockin: Read four job sites (YC, Built In Vancouver, Bay Street Oracle, Hacker News); remove a real Notion id and the owner's city (today). portfolio: the site now speaks to AI bots without changing a pixel: llms.txt, llms-full.txt and a markdown copy built from the same data the page renders; schema.org structured data; the whole page as plain text for crawlers that don't run scripts; every AI crawler named and welcome in robots.txt; a read-only /mcp server so an agent can ask about me instead of scraping (today). lockin: Fill the watchlist with 46 verified employer boards; exclude sales and recruiting titles (today). bide: Fix the scoreboard's day-mixing bug, pool model settings, clearer chart, calmer touch (1d ago). bide: Expose eggs on the debug handle (2d ago)
